window.title: Andrew Pang
window.summary: Welcome to my website! I am an experienced Software Engineer in the Finance domain. I build mobile apps that empower millions on their financial journeys, bringing ideas to life at blazing speeds.

window.title: Crypto.com
window.summary: Crypto.com is a cryptocurrency exchange company that offers various financial services, including an app, exchange, and noncustodial DeFi wallet, NFT marketplace, and direct payment service in cryptocurrency. It consistently ranks amongst the 10 cryptocurrency exchanges globally
bullets: Hired as a pioneering engineer in the React Native foundation team.
Spearheaded development of a cross-platform React Native design system.
Drove significant adoption in design system components by incorporating Generative AI into dev workflows.

window.title: MoneyLion
window.summary: MoneyLion is an industry leader in fintech, powering the next generation of personalized financial products and content, with a top consumer finance super app, a premier embedded finance platform for enterprise businesses and a world-class media arm. It ranks amongst the top 10 financial apps in the Apple App Store and Google Play Store in the US.
bullets: Hired as a graduate engineer to replace 2 mid-level engineers. Promoted after 1 year.
Led and mentored a team of 2 engineers in the development of stocks, ETFs, and crypto products.
Indentified wastage and optimised front-end operations to reduce monthly infrastructure cost.
Brainstormed product ideas to increase user onboarding onto investing products.

window.title: Setel
window.summary: Introduced in July 2018, Setel is first mobile app in Malaysia that is designed to ease motorists’ journey across fuelling, parking, EV charging, motor insurance, road tax, auto assistance, general purchases and more across an ecosystem of PETRONAS petrol stations, retail partners, and online merchants.
bullets: Collaborated with developers to launch a point-of-sales system deployed in 1600+ fuel stations in Malaysia.
Enhanced UI/UX for a station operator monitoring tool, reducing time and complexity to perform crucial tasks.

window.title: Monash University PRIME Program
window.summary: Monash University PRIME Program is a research project that aims to deliver prediabetes healthcare service and education through a mobile application. It educates patients with prediabetes on their condition and ways to prevent diabetes and empowers them to self-monitor and self-manage their condition.
bullets: Lead team of 6 to build a pre-diabetes detection and intervention app in collaboration with a local pharmacy
Leveraged AI predictive analytics to identify 100+ pre-diabetic users and connect them with pharmacists
Gold Award in the 33rd International Invention, Innovation & Technology Exhibition (ITEX), 2022
